headline: Olam Agri Plans $400 Million Investment in African Food Processing
summary: Olam Agri plans to invest approximately $400 million in African food processing through 2028, including building new animal feed mills in Nigeria, Cameroon, and Ivory Coast.
why: Large-scale agricultural investments expand regional supply chains and processing capacity across emerging markets in Sub-Saharan Africa.

impacts.name: Olam Agri
impacts.why: Capital deployment into expansion initiatives aims to scale long-term revenue.
